title: Select and persist sales demand evidence from the preloading business screen
description: Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Provide a functional saved-draft pre-loading row action and source-demand dialog using existing UI conventions. Load persisted document and line ids, query bounded authorized sales-order-candidates and show order/customer/product/spec/base unit and remaining quantity. User explicitly assigns or clears exact SourceSalesOrderDetailId for each existing line, submits sales-order-links and reloads server persisted result. New documents must save successfully before assigning server line ids; never invent ids or infer links from text. Approved/cancelled documents remain read-only.

Preserve demand links across normal detail editing and reopening, mark historical null links as unlinked and expose unavailable evidence without silently clearing it. Denied/revoked menu, foreign customer, wrong unit/product, stale capacity/status or network failures preserve draft inputs and display server failure; block double submission and stale line selections. Server transaction/authorization remains authoritative. Validate real API SQL linked/create/edit/clear round-trip and denied batch unchanged plus executable JS interaction tests; record real isolated browser workflow if available, otherwise accurate browser blocker.

implementation_evidence: ERP368 provides actual sales-order-candidates and sales-order-links routes, but pre-loading rowActions and bill editor expose no SourceSalesOrderDetailId selector. Users cannot complete explicit demand linkage through the business screen.
